pred_ddx.label: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML)
supports: JC virus infection is a common cause of PML, especially in immunocompromised patients
diffuse CNS involvement and multifocal lesions in cerebral cortex, subcortical areas and cerebellum are consistent with PML
immunosuppressed state due to chemotherapy and bone marrow transplant increases the risk of PML

pred_ddx.label: Primary CNS Lymphoma
supports: past medical history of acute lymphoblastic leukemia increases the risk of developing Primary CNS Lymphoma
relapse involving the central nervous system and bone marrow, leading to encephalopathy, is consistent with Primary CNS Lymphoma
raised CSF protein and low CSF:glucose ratio are indicative of Primary CNS Lymphoma
